question: Read the 13 submissions posted to docket IRS-2023-0053 between 2026-05-13 and 2026-06-15 (AEF, RCF x2, Ren, SIFMA, ABA x2, NYSBA, Kallina, Adler & Colvin, 'CF (Jenn Holcomb)', 'MCF (Bob Sorge)', AEF). Use an owner-registered regulations.gov API key, or have the owner download the PDFs. Record what each asks Treasury to do on adviser-managed DAFs, fees and Form 990 reporting, and whether any refers to a meeting or a draft

question: Measure the 2025 pull-forward and any 2026 pull-back in DAF contributions. Collect CY2026 results from Fidelity Charitable, DAFgiving360, Vanguard Charitable and NPT (due Jan–Mar 2027), with contributions, account openings and Q4 shares. Add the FY2025 and FY2026 Schedule D contribution lines for the top 20 sponsors from IRS e-file XML when posted
conclusion_affected: Size and durability of the OBBBA bunching effect; whether 2025 DAF inflow growth is a one-off that inflates the trend lines used in market sizing
rationale: Fidelity (accounts +13.4%, attributed to bunching) and DAFgiving360 (via InvestmentNews) report acceleration into 2025. Giving USA's estimate is about $1.71bn accelerated. No sponsor publishes contributions by month or any 2026 figure
